active.description: False while the invitation is pending (no password chosen yet).

Action.description:
Every kind of state change. The stored text is part of the audit record:
never rename a value, only add new ones.

email.description: Email of an existing Studio account.

deploymentId.description: The production deployment the approval queued.

releaseCreatedBy.description: Who made the release: they cannot approve it.

requestedBy.description: Who asked for production: they cannot approve it either.

canDecide.description: Whether the person reading may approve or reject it now.

productionVersion.description: The release production runs (or ran when the request was decided).

tests.description: The scenarios' results on the release, added up.

ApprovalReviewResponse.description: What an approver reviews: the request, production now, what changes and the tests.

oneOf.description: Who made the change; absent for changes Studio made on its own.
The person the change is about (a member added…), when there is one.

total.description: Events matching the filter, across all pages.

BumpRequest.description: Which part of the version the release raises.

hint.description: The token's last characters, to tell tokens apart.

lastUsedAt.description: When a pipeline last used it.

key.description: Lowercase words with single hyphens; folders separated by `/`.

notes.description: What the release changes, for approvers and the history.

name.description: Unique among the decision's scenarios (any case).

fromVersion.description: The version production runs, if any.

oneOf.description: The scenarios' results on the version the release brings.

toVersion.description: The version the release brings, if any.

outcomeField.description:
The output field whose value is a record's outcome, as a dotted path
(`decision`, `result.band`); `null` for none. Read when a record arrives.

redactedFields.description:
Fields removed from a record before it is sent to be explained, as
dotted paths; left out, they stay as they are.

outcomeField.description:
The output field whose value is a record's outcome, as a dotted path
(`decision`, `result.band`); `null` for none. Read when a record arrives.

redactedFields.description:
Fields removed from a record before it is sent to be explained, as
dotted paths (`applicant.nationalId`).

changedSinceVersion.description: Whether the draft has changed since that version (true before the first).

key.description: How graphs call this decision, e.g. `bureau/normalize`.

latestVersion.description: The number of its latest version; absent before the first "Save version".

revision.description: Grows by one on every save; send it back when saving.

total.description: Versions of the decision, across all pages.

restoredFrom.description: The older version this one restores, when it does.

tests.description: How the project's test scenarios went when this version was saved.

nextAttemptAt.description: When the next write is tried, while it waits.

rollbackReason.description: Why production was rolled back, for a rollback.

EnvironmentName.description: One of the two environments every project has.

oneOf.description: The latest deployment asked for, which may still be on its way.
The deployment live now (the release customer systems get).

details.description: Engine error document (failing node and reason) for evaluation failures.

message.description: Safe to show to a person.

requestId.description: Same value as the `x-request-id` response header; quote it when reporting a problem.

ExplainLanguage.description: The language Studio is read in.

language.description: The language to explain in: the reader's.

explanation.description: Plain text, in the language asked for. Shown only: it changes nothing.

model.description: The model that answered, as the endpoint names it.

FeedBatch.description: A batch of records, as a Runtime sends it (docs/decision-log-feed.md).

records.description: At most 1000 records; each is checked on its own.

accepted.description: Records stored, now or before (a record sent twice is stored once).

rejected.description: Records not stored, with why: `invalid`, `wrong_environment` or `unknown_release`.

oneOf.description: Language of the invitation email and of the account. Defaults to the inviter's.

name.description: Who uses the token, e.g. the loan origination system or a CI pipeline.

token.description: The token. Shown this once: Studio keeps only its hash.

The token. Shown this once: Studio keeps only its hash.

Locale.description: Language of a user's emails and screens.

environment.description: The environment whose Runtimes send records with it.

hint.description: The token's last characters, to tell tokens apart.

MatchMode.description: How much of the output a scenario pins down.

MismatchResponse.description:
One field where the output differs: `path` is dotted (`decision.limit`),
empty for the whole output; a side is absent when the field is missing there.

NextVersionsResponse.description: The version each bump would give the next release.

token.description: The token from the password-setup link.

total.description: Projects matching the filter, across all pages.

archivedAt.description: Set when the project is archived (read-only).

role.description: The reader's role in the project.

error.description: The error the caller received, when it failed.

explainable.description: Whether this installation can explain the record (DNK-19).

output.description: What it answered, when it succeeded.

trace.description: The engine's per-node trace, when the Runtime had one.

RecordStatus.description: Whether the Runtime answered or the evaluation failed.

durationUs.description: How long the Runtime took, in microseconds.

outcome.description: The project's outcome field when the record arrived; `error` for failures.

reason.description: Why the release may not go to production.

ReleasePreviewResponse.description: What a release made now would hold.

latest.description: The latest release's version; none before the first release.

unversioned.description: Decisions without a version: a release cannot be made while any remain.

liveIn.description: The environments this release is live in.

tests.description: The scenarios' results on the frozen versions, added up.
How the project's scenarios went on that version.

version.description: The version of the decision the release froze.

error.description: The engine's error, when the replay failed.

identical.description: Both succeeded with the same output, or both failed.

revision.description: The draft revision the editor shows; `409 DECISION_CONFLICT` when it moved on.

decision.description: The decision, its draft now the restored content.

version.description: The new version the restore created.

Role.description:
What a member may do in a project. Each role includes the ones below it;
variants are declared from least to most, so `Ord` follows that order.

reason.description: Why production goes back, for the audit log and the team.

releaseId.description: A release once approved for production, not the one live now.

items.description: Releases once approved for production, except the live one, newest first.

revision.description: The revision this draft was loaded or last saved at.

message.description: What changed and why, for the history.

revision.description: The draft revision the editor shows: the version is exactly that draft.

SimulateRequest.description:
Design-time evaluation from the editor. The editor sends the whole draft
project so sub-decision references resolve exactly as they will in a release.

decisions.description: Every decision of the project (JDM documents), keyed as graphs reference them.

trace.description: Per-node trace: inputs, outputs and timing of each node.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the download.

url.description: Relative to the API base path; download it with the same token.

deployments.description: At most 50; each is answered on its own.

id.description: Send it back as `current.commitId` to be told `no_change`.

alias.description: Echoed back, to tell answers apart.

oneOf.description: What the pipeline already holds; a match answers `no_change`.

nextPollAt.description: Always `null`: Studio does not ask pipelines to poll.

oneOf.description: The snapshot held after a load: the release, or for `env:` the deployment.

TestResultResponse.description: A scenario as it ran on the version, and what happened.

actual.description: What the decision returned; absent when it could not run.

error.description: It could not run: the engine's message.

missingDecision.description: It could not run because this decision has no saved version.

TestSummaryResponse.description: How the project's scenarios went on a version.

errors.description: Scenarios that could not run (a decision without a version, an evaluation error).

hint.description: The token's last characters, to tell tokens apart.

name.description: Unique among the decision's scenarios (any case).

version.description: Release version baked in at build time, or `unknown` for a local build.

info.description: Control plane of Donka: authoring, simulation, releases.
info.title: Donka Studio API

get.summary: The signed-in user.

202.description: If the address has an account, a reset link is on its way

post.summary:
Emails a one-time link to choose a new password. Answers the same whether or
not the address has an account, so it cannot be used to find accounts.

204.description: Password set; sign in with it

400.description: Link invalid, used or expired (INVALID_SETUP_LINK), or password too short or too long (INVALID_REQUEST)

post.summary: Sets a password from a one-time setup link. Ends the user's other sessions.

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

401.description: Email or password is incorrect, or the account is locked (INVALID_CREDENTIALS)

post.summary: Signs in and sets the httpOnly session cookie.
Ends the session on the server and clears the cookie.

400.description: Not a batch, or more than 1000 records (INVALID_REQUEST, TOO_MANY_RECORDS)

post.summary: Receives the records a Runtime sends (`Authorization: Bearer <decision-log token>`).

get.summary: Every decision-log token, live ones first; never their value (administrators).

post.summary:
Issues a token Runtimes of one environment send their records with
(administrators). The token is in this response only.

delete.summary: Revokes a decision-log token: batches sent with it are refused from now on (administrators).

get.summary: Liveness: answers as long as the process serves requests. Does not touch the database.

parameters.description: `true` lists archived projects instead of active ones.
parameters.name: archived

get.summary: Projects the signed-in user is a member of, by name.

post.summary: Creates a project (administrators only). The creator becomes its owner.

404.description: No such project, or not a member (PROJECT_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary:
A project the signed-in user is a member of, found by its key: the web app
addresses projects by key so its links stay short and readable.

404.description: No such project, or not a member (PROJECT_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: A project the signed-in user is a member of.

patch.summary: Renames the project or changes its description (owners). The key never changes.

get.summary: The project's production requests, newest first (any member).

post.summary:
Asks for the release live on staging to go to production; the owners who
may decide are emailed (editors and owners).

get.summary: One request with what it would change in production and its test results (any member).

422.description: SELF_APPROVAL (you made the release or asked for it)

post.summary:
Approves a request: the release is queued for production (owners who
neither made the release nor asked).

422.description: SELF_APPROVAL (you made the release or asked for it)

post.summary: Rejects a request with a reason (owners who neither made the release nor asked).
Withdraws a request (the person who asked).
Archives the project: read-only and hidden from the default list (owners).

parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (default 50). Ignored by the export.
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: The project's audit log, newest first (owners).

parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (default 50). Ignored by the export.
parameters.name: limit

200.description: CSV: occurred_at, actor, action, target, details

get.summary:
The project's audit log as CSV, with the same filters (owners). At most
50,000 rows; narrow the dates for more.
The project's CI tokens, live ones first; never their value (any member).

post.summary: Issues a read-only CI token for the project (owners). The token is in this response only.

delete.summary: Revokes a CI token (owners); pipelines using it are refused from then on.

parameters.description: Only this outcome, exactly (`error` for failed evaluations).
parameters.name: outcome

get.summary:
The project's decision records, newest first (any member). Lists hold
nothing the decisions read or answered.
The project's decision-log settings (any member).

400.description: Not dotted paths of field names (INVALID_REQUEST)

put.summary:
Names the output field read as each new record's outcome and the fields
removed before a record is explained (owners). Records already stored keep
the outcome they arrived with.

get.summary:
Opens a decision record (any member). Each opening is audited
(`decision_record.viewed`): records hold applicants' personal data.

404.description: NOT_FOUND (explanations are off), PROJECT_NOT_FOUND or RECORD_NOT_FOUND

422.description: The service declined to explain it (EXPLAIN_DECLINED)

502.description: The service failed or did not answer (EXPLAIN_UNAVAILABLE)

post.summary:
Explains a record in plain language with the installation's LLM endpoint
(any member). The project's redacted fields are removed first. Audited
(`decision_record.explained`) before anything is sent. `404` when the
installation does not explain decisions.

get.summary: The project's decisions, by key (any member).

422.description: The content is not a decision model (INVALID_DECISION)

post.summary: A new decision, empty unless content is given (editors and owners).

delete.summary:
Deletes a decision (editors and owners): it leaves the project and its key
is free again; its versions stay in the history.

get.summary: One decision with its draft (any member).

409.description: DECISION_CONFLICT (details: revision, updatedAt, updatedBy) or PROJECT_ARCHIVED

422.description: The content is not a decision model (INVALID_DECISION)

put.summary:
Saves the draft (editors and owners). Send the revision the draft was loaded
at: when someone saved since, the answer is `409 DECISION_CONFLICT` with who
and when in `details`, and nothing is overwritten.

422.description: A decision of the project is not a valid model (INVALID_DECISION), or the evaluation failed (EVALUATION_FAILED, trace in details)

post.summary:
Evaluates this decision with every other decision of the project, as a
release would, and returns the result with a per-node trace (any member:
viewers simulate too). Nothing is saved.

get.summary: The decision's versions, newest first (any member).

409.description: DECISION_CONFLICT (the draft moved on) or PROJECT_ARCHIVED

422.description: Nothing changed since the latest version (VERSION_UNCHANGED, details: version)

post.summary: Saves the draft as the next version (editors and owners).

get.summary: One version with its content, to compare or restore (any member).

409.description: DECISION_CONFLICT (the draft moved on) or PROJECT_ARCHIVED

post.summary:
Restores a version (editors and owners): its content becomes the draft and a
new version; the history only grows.

get.summary: How every scenario of the project went when this version was saved (any member).
Both environments: what is live, what was last asked for, how many tokens (any member).
An environment's deployments, newest first (any member).

post.summary:
Deploys a release to staging (editors and owners). The artifact is
written after the request, retried on failure; follow it on the
environment. Production is published through an approval.

409.description: NOT_RETRYABLE (it did not give up) or PROJECT_ARCHIVED

post.summary: Tries a deployment that gave up again now (editors and owners).

get.summary: An environment's Runtime tokens, live ones first; never their value (any member).

post.summary:
Issues a Runtime token for the environment (owners). The token is in this
response only; the environment's release is published again so the
Runtime accepts it.

delete.summary: Revokes a Runtime token (owners); the environment's release is published again without it.

get.summary: Members of the project, owners first, then by email (any member).

post.summary: Adds an existing Studio user to the project (owners).

delete.summary: Removes a member; the last owner cannot be removed (owners).

patch.summary: Changes a member's role; a project always keeps an owner (owners).

get.summary: The project's releases, newest first (any member).

409.description: RELEASE_CONFLICT (someone released at the same moment) or PROJECT_ARCHIVED

post.summary: Freezes the latest version of every decision as a new release (editors and owners).

get.summary: What a release made now would hold, and the version each bump would give (any member).
One release with the version of each decision it froze (any member).

post.summary: Restores an archived project (owners).

get.summary: The releases production can be rolled back to (any member).

post.summary:
Puts a release once approved for production back in production, with a
reason and without a new approval (owners).

parameters.description: Only the scenarios of this decision.
parameters.name: decisionId

get.summary: The project's scenarios, by decision and name (any member).

400.description: Invalid name, input or expected output (INVALID_REQUEST, fields)

post.summary: A new scenario for one of the project's decisions (editors and owners).

delete.summary: Deletes a scenario (editors and owners). Results already recorded stay.

get.summary: One scenario (any member).

400.description: Invalid name, input or expected output (INVALID_REQUEST, fields)

put.summary: Changes a scenario (editors and owners). Results already recorded keep it as it ran.

get.summary: Readiness: the service can handle requests that need the database.

400.description: Not a request, or more than 50 deployments (INVALID_REQUEST)

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked CI token (INVALID_TOKEN)

post.summary:
Resolves the targets a pipeline asks for (`Authorization: Bearer <CI token>`).
A token reaches only its own project; any other answers `no_access`.

404.description: Not this token's project, or no such published deployment (RELEASE_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary:
An environment's artifact as its Runtime reads it, tokens included, with
the CI token of its project.

404.description: Not this token's project, or no such release (RELEASE_NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: A release's artifact (no environment, no token), with the CI token of its project.

422.description: Invalid decision model (INVALID_DECISION) or evaluation error (EVALUATION_FAILED)

get.summary: Every Studio account, by email (administrators only).

201.description: Account created; the invitation email is on its way

409.description: The person already has an account (EMAIL_TAKEN)

post.summary:
Invites a person by email (administrators only). Inviting someone who has not
accepted yet sends a new link and revokes the previous one.

get.summary: The version of Studio that is running. Needs no session, like health.
